All 4 tests pass (the `checksum` warning is a pre-existing unused function, unrelated to this change).

The eviction policy in `src/store.rs` now drops by write order instead of read recency:

- `Entry` tracks `written` (set once, at first insertion) instead of `used` (touched on every access).
- `insert` on an existing key updates the value in place and leaves `written` untouched, so it doesn't move.
- `get` no longer mutates any ordering state — it's a pure read.
- Eviction (`evict_oldest_write`) picks the entry with the smallest `written` value.
